title.en: Diplomatic and Consular Relations (Commonwealth Secretariat) Order 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Diplomatic and Consular Relations (Commonwealth Secretariat) Order 2008.

heading.en: Additional immunity of high officers and members of the staff

text.en:
3. Every high officer or member of the staff of the Commonwealth Secretariat enjoys and has, when present in Singapore on any Commonwealth mission, in addition to his or her immunities and privileges under the International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (Commonwealth Secretariat) Order 2008, inviolability of his or her documents and papers relating to the work of the Commonwealth Secretariat, except insofar as in any particular case that immunity is waived —
(a)in the case of a high officer (not being the Secretary‑General) or member of the staff of the Commonwealth Secretariat — by the Secretary‑General or the Commonwealth Secretariat; or
(b)in the case of the Secretary‑General — by the Commonwealth Heads of Government, the Board of Governors of the Commonwealth or the Commonwealth Secretariat.
